rootCause.rootCause: The `is_whitespace` attribute is set to `False` for `RawSegment` instances by default in `BaseSegment.is_whitespace = False` (src/sqlfluff/core/parser/segments/base.py#L55-L90). This is a machine-protected invariant because ordinary code segments must remain non-whitespace. The `RawSegment.make` method (src/sqlfluff/core/parser/segments/raw.py#L1-L145) is used to create segment classes, and it passes `is_whitespace` as a keyword argument to the `RawSegment` class. However, the `is_whitespace` flag is not being set correctly for whitespace tokens in the `dialect_ansi` configuration (src/sqlfluff/core/dialects/dialect_ansi.py#L45-L95).
evidence: src/sqlfluff/core/parser/segments/raw.py#L1-L145: RawSegment.make() passes is_whitespace to the class
src/sqlfluff/core/dialects/dialect_ansi.py#L45-L95: whitespace regex is defined but is_whitespace is not explicitly set for the segment class
src/sqlfluff/core/rules/base.py#L395-L425: make_whitespace() explicitly sets is_whitespace=True for whitespace segments
filesToChange: src/sqlfluff/core/dialects/dialect_ansi.py#L45-L95: Ensure is_whitespace is set for whitespace segment class
rootCause.risk: Changing `is_whitespace = False` in `BaseSegment` would break the invariant that ordinary code segments must remain non-whitespace. This could lead to incorrect parsing and analysis of SQL code.
